mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval (tenant_id, operation_id, state, requirement, argument_digest, target_resource, approver_scope, approver_id, expires_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{operationId}::uuid, 'APPROVED', #{requirement}, #{argumentDigest}, #{targetResource}, #{approverScope}, #{approverId}, #{expiresAt})

INSERT INTO approval (tenant_id, operation_id, state, requirement, argument_digest, target_resource, approver_scope, expires_at) SELECT #{tenantId}::uuid, #{operationId}::uuid, 'PENDING', #{requirement}, #{argumentDigest}, #{targetResource}, #{approverScope}, #{expiresAt} WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approval WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND operation_id = #{operationId}::uuid) RETURNING approval_id::text
mapper.update: UPDATE approval SET state = 'REJECTED', approver_id = #{approverId}, decided_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND operation_id = #{operationId}::uuid
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenantId, approval_id::text AS approvalId, operation_id::text AS operationId, state::text AS state, requirement::text AS requirement, argument_digest AS argumentDigest, target_resource AS targetResource, approver_scope AS approverScope, expires_at AS expiresAt, approver_id AS approverId, decided_at AS decidedAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM approval WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND operation_id = #{operationId}::uuid
SELECT state::text AS state, cancel_requested_at AS cancelRequestedAt FROM run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND run_id = #{runId}::uuid FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE approval SET state = 'CONSUMED', consumed_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND operation_id = #{operationId}::uuid
UPDATE approval SET state = 'EXPIRED', decided_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND operation_id = #{operationId}::uuid
